sn22.115:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.115:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, dhammakathiko hotīti.
sn22.115:1.5: rūpassa ce bhikkhu, nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, “dhammakathiko bhikkhū”ti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn22.115:1.6: rūpassa ce bhikkhu, nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti, “dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhū”ti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn22.115:1.7: rūpassa ce bhikkhu, nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti, “diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhū”ti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn22.115:1.11: viññāṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, “dhammakathiko bhikkhū”ti alaṃ vacanāya.
